title: dbx DriveRack PA2
description: Levels, dynamics, routing and audit trail for dbx DriveRack PA2 units, via pa2_exporter.

panels.title: LOW LIMITER
panels.description: Limiter activity for this band, read pre-mute exactly like the front-panel lamp.

panels.title: MID LIMITER
panels.description: Limiter activity for this band, read pre-mute exactly like the front-panel lamp.

panels.title: HIGH LIMITER
panels.description: Limiter activity for this band, read pre-mute exactly like the front-panel lamp.

panels.title: INPUT
panels.description: Peak input level per channel within the rolling window — the closest equivalent to the hardware's input meters.

panels.title: PRESET
panels.description: Preset currently recalled on the device.

panels.title: STORE
panels.description: Lights when the preset has been edited but not stored — the state the hardware's STORE lamp warns about.

panels.title: OUTPUT
panels.description: Post-mute output level per band and channel. Muted outputs sit at the bottom of the scale, as they do on the hardware.

panels.title: L
panels.description: Mute state for this output.

panels.title: R
panels.description: Mute state for this output.

panels.title: L
panels.description: Mute state for this output.

panels.title: R
panels.description: Mute state for this output.

panels.title: L
panels.description: Mute state for this output.

panels.title: R
panels.description: Mute state for this output.

panels.title: Device
panels.description: Session alive and authenticated. Offline is a real state, not a broken exporter — it keeps serving and reconnects on its own.

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Share of the selected time range the exporter was talking to the device.

panels.title: Loaded preset
panels.description: Preset name and number currently recalled on the device.

panels.title: Preset state
panels.description: Front-panel edits that have not been stored to the preset.

panels.title: Last update
panels.description: Age of the newest value pushed by the device. A healthy PA2 pushes meters continuously, so a growing number means a stalled session.

panels.title: Reconnects
panels.description: Sessions lost in the selected range. Steady growth points at a flaky network path rather than a dead device.

panels.title: Firmware
panels.description: Device instance name and firmware version.

panels.title: Input level · $channel
panels.description: Peak/average/floor within each rolling window, so transients between scrapes are not lost. The shaded band is the full dynamic range seen.

panels.title: Output level · $band
panels.description: Post-mute output level per crossover band. Drops to the -120 dB floor when the band is muted.

panels.title: Limiter gain reduction
panels.description: How hard each band's limiter is working. Sustained deep reduction means the system is being driven past its headroom.

panels.title: Limiter threshold state
panels.description: Pre-mute limiter state per band, so it reports even while the outputs are muted.

panels.title: Compressor gain reduction
panels.description: Bus compressor gain reduction across the rolling window.

panels.title: Input clips
panels.description: Clip events at the inputs. Anything above zero means somebody upstream is sending too much level.

panels.title: Output mutes
panels.description: Mute state per output. Gaps mean the exporter lost the device — stale state is deliberately not drawn.

panels.title: Output trim
panels.description: Per-output gain trim currently stored in the preset.

panels.title: Feedback suppression
panels.description: Active feedback-suppression filters. A climbing count during a show usually means a mic is on the edge of ringing.

panels.title: Settings changed on the device
panels.description: Audit trail of tweaks made at the front panel or from the control app, grouped by module.

panels.title: Changes in range
panels.description: Total edits per module across the selected range.

panels.title: Preset recalls
panels.description: Preset recalls in the selected range. Each one is also marked as an annotation on the time series above.
